text:
[{"word":"bird","pronun":"[bɜːrd]","translation":"n. 鸟；家伙；羽毛球
vt. 向…喝倒彩；起哄
vi. 猎鸟；观察研究野鸟","audio":"bird.mp3"},{"word":"bull","pronun":"[bʊl]","translation":"n. 公牛；看好股市者；粗壮如牛的人；胡说八道；印玺
adj. 大型的；公牛似的；雄性的
vt. 企图抬高证券价格；吓唬；强力实现
vi. 价格上涨；走运；猛推；吹牛","audio":"bull.mp3"},{"word":"butterfly","pronun":"[ˈbʌtərflaɪ]","translation":"n. 蝴蝶；蝶泳；举止轻浮的人；追求享乐的人","audio":"butterfly.mp3"},{"word":"camel","pronun":"[ˈkæm(ə)l]","translation":"n. [畜牧][脊椎] 骆驼；打捞浮筒；工作作风官僚
adj. 驼色的；暗棕色的
vi. 工作刻板平庸","audio":"camel.mp3"},{"word":"cat","pronun":"[kæt]","translation":"n. 猫，猫科动物","audio":"cat.mp3"},{"word":"chicken","pronun":"[ˈtʃɪkɪn]","translation":"n. 鸡肉；小鸡；胆小鬼，懦夫
adj. 鸡肉的；胆怯的；幼小的","audio":"chicken.mp3"},{"word":"cow","pronun":"[kaʊ]","translation":"n. 奶牛，母牛；母兽
vt. 威胁，恐吓","audio":"cow.mp3"},{"word":"dog","pronun":"[dɔːɡ]","translation":"n. 狗；卑鄙的人；(俚)朋友
vt. 跟踪；尾随","audio":"dog.mp3"},{"word":"dolphin","pronun":"[ˈdɑːlfɪn]","translation":"n. 海豚","audio":"dolphin.mp3"},{"word":"duck","pronun":"[dʌk]","translation":"n. 鸭子；鸭肉；（英）宝贝儿；零分
vt. 躲避；猛按…入水
vi. 闪避；没入水中","audio":"duck.mp3"},{"word":"elephant","pronun":"[ˈelɪfənt]","translation":"n. 象；大号图画纸","audio":"elephant.mp3"},{"word":"fish","pronun":"[fɪʃ]","translation":"n. 鱼，鱼类
vt. 钓鱼，捕鱼；搜寻
vi. 捕鱼，钓鱼；用钩捞取","audio":"fish.mp3"},{"word":"fur","pronun":"[fɜːr]","translation":"n. 皮，皮子；毛皮；软毛
n. 水垢
vt. 用毛皮覆盖；使穿毛皮服装","audio":"fur.mp3"},{"word":"giraffe","pronun":"[dʒəˈræf]","translation":"n. 长颈鹿","audio":"giraffe.mp3"},{"word":"goat","pronun":"[goʊt]","translation":"n. 山羊；替罪羊（美俚）；色鬼（美俚）","audio":"goat.mp3"},{"word":"horse","pronun":"[hɔːrs]","translation":"n. 马；骑兵；脚架；海洛因
vt. 使骑马；系马于；捉弄
vi. 骑马；作弄人","audio":"horse.mp3"},{"word":"insect","pronun":"[ˈɪnsekt]","translation":"n. 昆虫；卑鄙的人","audio":"insect.mp3"},{"word":"kitten","pronun":"[ˈkɪt(ə)n]","translation":"n. 小猫；小动物
vi. 产小猫","audio":"kitten.mp3"},{"word":"lamb","pronun":"[læm]","translation":"n. 羔羊，小羊；羔羊肉
vt. 生小羊，产羔羊
vi. 生小羊，产羔羊","audio":"lamb.mp3"},{"word":"lion","pronun":"[ˈlaɪən]","translation":"n. 狮子；名人；勇猛的人；社交场合的名流","audio":"lion.mp3"}]
